author: permawl
quote: My GOTY, a hard choice between this and Control, but the introduction to this game is top tier, and all the technical aspects of it + the well crafted eyecandy level motion capture and acting just make this game look and behave to good. On top of that, the combat, is so satisfying and paired with industry leading level of motion capture, it carries a feel and weight you'll find almost no other game.

author: permawl
quote:
Forcing you into a relationship is not controversial imo, it's a video game with a set story that the devs decided, like any other game. The issue is that one partner is an abusive alcoholic narcissistic as***** of a deadbeat mom and the other is also an alcoholic narcissistic as***** of a f*** up man. Like I get it, it's fiction, and we want to embrace certain feelings through certain motifs and scenarios, but this is too much, too annoying and too uninspiring. And the stuff they sacrificed to focus on this awful relationship between the two MC, just makes the game fundamentally worse. It'd be better if one of the MCs didn't exist and you'd have the freedom.
Also, the game runs like shi* and is riddled with bugs.
